summary: Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results release scheduled for May 7, 2026, with a conference call to follow. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or special event is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings schedule notification by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a domestic earnings press release on Form 8-K. There are no deal terms, stakes, premiums, or structural changes. This filing does not constitute a special situation; it is a standard financial reporting update with no actionable corporate event for risk-arb analysis.
